name: artemis-whats-new
title: What's new
description: A corner teaser with stacked thumbnails opens a release dialog with one feature per slide: drifting media or custom animated media, highlights, a try-it action, step dots, swipe and arrow-key navigation, and a finish step that links to the full changelog

files.content:
// @zeus-internal
export const slides = [
    {
        title: "Share one board with a client",
        description: "Invite guests to a single Workspace board without giving them a seat in your workspace.",
        highlights: ["Guests only see the boards you share.", "Links expire after 30 days unless you extend them.", "Every guest edit lands in the board history."],
        kind: "New feature",
        image: "/assets/artemis/073f31f79f11db785cc3.webp",
        alt: "Watercolor valley artwork for guest boards",
        imageTransform: "translateX(-2.5%) translateY(-1.5%) scale(1.14)",
        link: { label: "Share a board", href: "#guest-boards" },
    },
    {
        title: "Cards move when the work does",
        description: "Set a rule once and Workspace moves cards to the next column when a review is approved.",
        highlights: ["Trigger on approvals, merged branches, or due dates.", "Every automatic move is labelled on the card."],
        kind: "New feature",
        image: null,
        alt: "",
        imageTransform: "none",
        link: { label: "Create a rule", href: "#auto-move" },
    },
    {
        title: "Timeline view, now with dependencies",
        description: "Drag a bar to reschedule and everything that depends on it shifts along with it.",
        highlights: ["Zoom between weeks, months, and quarters.", "Drag a bar's edge to change its length."],
        kind: "Improvement",
        image: "/assets/artemis/9067ea32893611dc0c24.webp",
        alt: "Pencil sketch of a winding path for the timeline view",
        imageTransform: "translateX(-1%) translateY(-1.5%) scale(1.13)",
        link: null,
    },
    {
        title: "Usage insights on every plan",
        description: "Active members, storage, and automation runs in one place, compared week over week.",
        highlights: ["Download any chart for your team update.", "Spot idle seats before your next renewal."],
        kind: "Improvement",
        image: "/assets/artemis/e77c0dbf503c1a11b633.webp",
        alt: "Isometric illustration of stacked metric blocks",
        imageTransform: "translateX(-2.5%) translateY(-1.5%) scale(1.14)",
        link: { label: "Open insights", href: "#insights" },
    },
] as const;

docs: artemis-whats-new: 3 demo images are not part of the shadcn install. Download from the URLs in meta.assets into the same public/ paths, or install with the zeus-ui CLI, which copies them.
